tonight.headline: Claims lock at 02:00 — and the claim's drop is in your K slot
body: Bad news first. Bhayshul Tuten missed a second straight practice on Tuesday (Heavy 3 Nov) with the ankle and foot, and plays Thursday night at Baltimore. Kyler Murray's hamstring still has no diagnosis; O'Connell is not sure about Monday, and Carson Wentz throws to Jefferson if he sits.

The owner set the bye fix this morning — Diggs in the FLEX, Gordon at RB, Likely at TE. As set AVIATO project 123.6 against Talla Metralla's 130.0. Tonight is the last chance for the Coker claim: the window closes overnight, at 02:00 Wednesday CDMX. Before it does, put Bass back at K — Fairbairn, now in the K slot, is the claim's drop.

case.label: Where the points are
case.body: ESPN gives AVIATO 47% on the lineups as set. The gap is 6.4 projected points; the lineup is within 0.6 of its best, so what is left to gain is Coker and Thursday's Tuten check.

case.label: Their soft spot
case.body: Michael Wilson starts for Talla Metralla through broken ribs (Athlon 2 Nov, carried from the morning; no newer report found).

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The projection lineup is set and AVIATO still trail by more than 10 after Sunday's early games — then the gap was roster, not lineup.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claims clear Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — tonight
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Still on Chem waivers in the 22:05Z file. The window closes overnight; if the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 28 Oct 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Coker — the card that morning said drop the spare kicker. AVIATO still carry two.

case.label: The player
case.body: Off the Panthers' report (shoulder) since 28 Oct; Week 8 at Green Bay 2 of 5 for 38 and a TD, plus a lost fumble (NBC 29 Oct). Bryce Young starts. Carolina host Denver; nothing new on Coker since 30 Oct.

case.label: Why now
case.body: Warren and Metcalf are on bye, Tuten has missed two practices, and AVIATO's only spare RB/WR is Kamara. Pittman aims to return in Week 10 (ClutchPoints 2 Nov), so Metcalf's share may shrink when Pittsburgh are back — a third receiver has a use.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn — a second kicker in a one-kicker league. He is in the K slot right now: see the next card.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive). Untested if a rival with higher priority takes him.

doFirst.title: Put Bass back at K, bench Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: 9.9 to 9.3 — a coin flip the projection takes. It matters because Fairbairn is the claim's drop.

case.label: What changed
case.body: At 14:46Z today the owner moved Fairbairn into K and Bass to the bench (activity log). The lineup check prefers Bass by 0.6 — inside the coin-flip line, so no thesis either way.

case.label: Why it is a card
case.body: If the Coker claim processes with Fairbairn in the K slot, the slot empties. Bass's game is Monday night, so it could still be fixed later — but only if someone remembers.

case.label: If you meant it
case.body: If the claim was entered as Coker for Bass instead, leave Fairbairn in K. Either way, the kicker in the slot must not be the one the claim drops.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Fairbairn outscores Bass in Week 9 (archive) — a coin flip, so a loss here says nothing about the read.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only — check Thu 5 Nov 17:45 CDMX
doFirst.title: If Tuten is inactive Thursday, start Kamara
doFirst.subtitle: Two missed practices; Wednesday's report gives him a designation, Thursday's inactive list decides.

case.label: The injury
case.body: Ankle/foot from early in Week 8 — he played through it for 159 scrimmage yards and two TDs. DNP Monday (estimated) and did not appear to practise Tuesday (Heavy 3 Nov).

case.label: The fallback
case.body: Kamara 9.0 is the only other healthy back: Warren is on bye. If Coker is claimed, he does not help here — Chem's FLEX is already Diggs.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is active and Kamara would have outscored him (archive) — the contingency only fires on an inactive.

whatWentWrong.title: The kicker swap points the claim at the starter
whatWentWrong.lead: Fairbairn went into the K slot at 14:46Z; the Coker claim drops Fairbairn.

case.label: What happened
case.body: The owner's lineup reset this morning fixed the bye (Diggs for Warren) and the TE, and also swapped the kickers — Fairbairn in, Bass out.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The Bass card above, before 02:00 Wednesday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The claim was entered dropping Bass — then the slot is right as set and the card is moot.

whatWentWrong.title: The D/ST add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: On 28 Oct the defence add cut Coker instead of the spare kicker; tonight's claim undoes it or nothing does.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Nothing in Week 8. In Week 9 AVIATO have one spare RB/WR, Kamara, behind a Tuten who has missed two practices.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The claim fails and Kamara and Diggs cover Week 9 with no loss against the projection lineup.

roster.footnote: No Week 9 game has started. Rows show the lineup as set at 22:05Z; verdicts show the projection lineup. Grades are rank in fantasy points allowed to the position, StatChasers weeks 1-8 updated 3 Nov (1 = toughest).

lineupCheck.verdict: The lineup as set is 0.6 below the projection lineup: the owner put Fairbairn in at K at 14:46Z; Bass 9.9 to 9.3 is a coin flip — take the projection. Tuten is conditional.

worthALook.name: Giants D/ST
worthALook.lead: At Philadelphia with Tanner McKee — the free-agent swap if Stafford is healthy.

case.label: The matchup
case.body: Hurts is on IR, expected out for the season; McKee starts (DK 3 Nov). Giants -3.5, total 39.5 (SI Betting 3 Nov).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: 7.5 against the Commanders' 6.2 is 1.3. The Commanders face the Rams, and Stafford's throwing arm is sore (RotoWire 2 Nov) — the Rams' Wednesday report decides which defence has the better week.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Thursday: if Stafford practises fully, add the Giants D/ST as a free agent after waivers clear (no claim) and drop the Commanders D/ST — that slot will be past seven days. If Stafford is limited or out, hold.

worthALook.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
worthALook.lead: On IR and on Chem waivers; his practice window could open Wednesday.

case.label: The player
case.body: Hamstring, on IR, eligible after New Orleans' Week 8 bye; Moore has not decided when to open the 21-day window (NBC 2 Nov), DK expects it could open Wednesday (3 Nov). He led the backfield before the injury (100%, 47%, 50% of carries in Weeks 1-3, archive).

case.label: Why not tonight
case.body: Chem has no IR slot, so he would sit on the bench for at least a week; AVIATO's spare roster spot goes to Coker. The only other drop would be Hockenson.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The window opens and the Saints say he plays in Week 10 — then he is worth a free-agent add for Hockenson, who has no route into Chem's lineup while Likely plays.

worthALook.name: Tyler Allgeier
worthALook.lead: Love to IR with a high ankle sprain — four games at least.

case.label: The vacancy
case.body: Jeremiyah Love is headed to IR (NBC/Rotoworld 3 Nov). Bam Knight left Week 8 with a concussion; his status sizes Allgeier's share at Seattle.

case.label: Why not yet
case.body: 36.1 on 16 touches (147 yards on 11 carries) is the efficiency signature; 9.3 projected is a coin flip with Kamara, the back he would replace.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten ruled out on Wednesday's report: then Allgeier as a free agent after 02:00 is a coin flip with Kamara, not a gain — still pass unless Knight is also out.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: 25 carries to Jeanty's two by Kubiak's call — and Kubiak won't commit to it again.

case.label: The player
case.body: First start, 25 carries for 83 at the Jets; Jeanty 2 carries and 3 catches for 64. Kubiak: Washington gave them the better chance, not discipline (ESPN, CBS 1-3 Nov).

case.label: Why not yet
case.body: No injury, one game, 3.3 a carry, no commitment. AVIATO's one drop goes to Coker.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco with Jeanty healthy.

case.label: What would change it

case.label: What would change it
